title: streblus zeylanicus
intro: Streblus zeylanicus, commonly known as the Common Corallinus or Indian Coral Tree, is a medicinal plant species native to tropical forests in Asia. The plant is known for its health benefits, which include its ability to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation and promoting digestion. The bioactive constituents of Streblus zeylanicus include tannins, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. The plant's extracts have been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various conditions, and its bioactive compounds have been studied for their potential antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
